Kernel subsystems move, one subsystem at a time, out of hand-written Rust models and into proven Thermite carried through the boundary registry, so the proportion of the running image that is certified rises monotonically.

```day-telos
{"witnesses":["verified-source"]}
```

Did not advance. The verified-source witness is material only because src/*.th exists, and its contents are the upstream trivial payload: one exported function whose postcondition is result > 0. No subsystem moved from hand-written Rust into proven Thermite this pass. A material witness is not an advanced telos, and this is the case that shows the difference. Blocked at T0 by upstream Thermite #122.
